findings.message: Deterministic golden-scene performance benchmark harness implemented with cold start, interaction latency, and FPS measurements. Provides reproducible performance validation.
Tier-aware benchmark configuration added for tier1 and tier2 with explicit thresholds. Enables hardware-tier-specific performance validation.
Performance CI gate script created and wired into scripts/run-quality-gates.sh, enabling automated performance validation in CI pipeline.
Performance gate executes all configured tiers by default. Environment variable export propagation to Godot process fixed, ensuring proper test execution environment.
Deployment configuration system implemented in deployment_config.gd, providing structured deployment profile management.
Feature flag service implemented in feature_flag_service.gd, enabling runtime feature toggling and rollout control.

Feature flag and deployment profile test coverage added in application suite: test_feature_flag_service.gd validates feature flag behavior, run_application_tests.gd includes profile/rollout controls validation.
All validation passes: run-performance-gates.sh (exit 0), run-application-suite.sh (exit 0), run-quality-gates.sh (exit 0). Performance thresholds suitable for release expectations.
Backlog.yaml updated to reflect TASK-039 implementation and dependencies.
